label: Diagram 10
caption: Diagram 10 Location of permanent air vent openings, some examples
description: This section of a house, titled "Diagram 10 Location of permanent air vent openings, some examples," shows airflow paths. At the top, under a pitched roof, is a "Well-ventilated roof space". Below this is a large interior area labelled "Living room (example)", containing a rectangular block labelled "Combustion appliance". To the right is a smaller room labelled "Hall". At the bottom is a "Suspended floor", with a "Well-ventilated space" beneath it. Black arrows indicate the direction of air movement. Arrows point inwards from the exterior on the left and right sides. Arrows lead to the "Combustion appliance" from the outside wall on the left and, through the "Hall", from the outside wall on the right. Additional arrows point upwards from the "Well-ventilated space" into the "Living room" and downwards from the "Well-ventilated roof space" into the "Living room".
